title: Stage B low case: given Stage A, a low vertex of a normal-form counterexample has at most two re-attachments
statement_en: Let n >= 3, d a natural number, and G a graph on Fin n in normal form NF(d): every degree is d or d + 1, and vertices of equal degree have isomorphic cards; let H be hypomorphic to G and not isomorphic to G (a counterexample pair). Write K for the family of labelled graphs on Fin n hypomorphic to G; K, K' agree off u if they have the same adjacency on every pair avoiding u; the re-attachment class C_G(u) is the set of members of K agreeing with G off u. Assume the Stage A conclusions (a)-(d) of the sibling extension_eigen hold for G (stated verbatim as a hypothesis, with the same let-abbreviations dg, ag, z). Then, for every vertex u of degree d (low) and any three members K1, K2, K3 of C_G(u), two of them are equal, i.e. |C_G(u)| <= 2 (Zinchenko Thm 4.4, low case; debe_zinchenko.md section 4, B1-B4, with A6 transport left to the builder).
statement_lean: ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → ∀ (d : ℕ) (G H : SimpleGraph (Fin n)), (∀ x : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = d ∨ (G.neighborSet x).ncard = d + 1) → (∀ x y : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = (G.neighborSet y).ncard → Nonempty (G.induce ({x}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)))) → Recon.Hypomorphic G H → ¬ Nonempty (G ≃g H) → (let dg := fun (K : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (x : Fin n) => (K.neighborSet x).ncard; let ag := fun (A B : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (u : Fin n) => ∀ x y : Fin n, x ≠ u → y ≠ u → (A.Adj x y ↔ B.Adj x y); let z := fun (A B : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (u y : Fin n) => (Set.indicator {w : Fin n | A.Adj u w} 1 y : ℤ) - Set.indicator {w : Fin n | B.Adj u w} 1 y; (∀ K : SimpleGraph (Fin n), Recon.Hypomorphic G K → ∀ x : Fin n, dg K x = d ∨ dg K x = d + 1) ∧ (∀ K : SimpleGraph (Fin n), Recon.Hypomorphic G K → ∀ u : Fin n, ∃ K' : SimpleGraph (Fin n), Recon.Hypomorphic G K' ∧ ag K K' u ∧ K' ≠ K) ∧ ∃ θ : ℤ, (∀ K₁ K₂ : SimpleGraph (Fin n), Recon.Hypomorphic G K₁ → Recon.Hypomorphic G K₂ → ∀ u : Fin n, ag K₁ K₂ u → ∀ x : Fin n, (dg K₁ x : ℤ) = dg K₂ x + z K₁ K₂ u x ∧ (x ≠ u → ∑ y : Fin n, Set.indicator {w : Fin n | K₁.Adj x w} (z K₁ K₂ u) y = (θ - (if dg K₁ u = d + 1 then 1 else 0)) * z K₁ K₂ u x)) ∧ ∀ K K₁ K₂ : SimpleGraph (Fin n), Recon.Hypomorphic G K → Recon.Hypomorphic G K₁ → Recon.Hypomorphic G K₂ → ∀ u : Fin n, ag K K₁ u → ag K K₂ u → K₁ ≠ K → K₂ ≠ K → Set.ncard {y : Fin n | K.Adj u y ∧ ¬ K₁.Adj u y} = Set.ncard {y : Fin n | K.Adj u y ∧ ¬ K₂.Adj u y} ∧ ∀ x : Fin n, dg K x = dg K u → (K₁.Adj u x ↔ K₂.Adj u x)) → ∀ u : Fin n, (G.neighborSet u).ncard = d → ∀ K₁ K₂ K₃ : SimpleGraph (Fin n), Recon.Hypomorphic G K₁ → Recon.Hypomorphic G K₂ → Recon.Hypomorphic G K₃ → (∀ x y : Fin n, x ≠ u → y ≠ u → (G.Adj x y ↔ K₁.Adj x y)) → (∀ x y : Fin n, x ≠ u → y ≠ u → (G.Adj x y ↔ K₂.Adj x y)) → (∀ x y : Fin n, x ≠ u → y ≠ u → (G.Adj x y ↔ K₃.Adj x y)) → K₁ = K₂ ∨ K₁ = K₃ ∨ K₂ = K₃
